answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because spiral only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, jade is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any plume approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
